name: ailang-lsp
description: AILANG language server (M-AILANG-LSP-FOR-AI). Wires the in-tree `ailang lsp` subcommand into Claude Code so an agent editing .ail files gets real-time diagnostics, hover types, go-to-definition, find-references, and document symbols. Requires the `ailang` binary on PATH (build with `make install` from the repo root).
